title: SGLang TP/DP/EP, PD transfer and extension ownership
summary: Resolve process groups and effective runtime configuration before changing distributed topology, models, attention or kernels.

zh-CN.title: SGLang TP/DP/EP、PD 传输与扩展职责
zh-CN.summary: 调整分布式拓扑、模型、注意力或内核前，明确进程组及生效的运行时配置。

conditions: Record rank/group sizes, dimensions, expert layout, accelerator memory, interconnect and workload.
Check model/backend divisibility and supported configuration in the pinned checkout.

recommendations: Distinguish replica DP from attention DP; for PD trace bootstrap identity, destination allocation, transfer completion and both-role cancellation.
Use the owning model, attention registry or kernel boundary; runtime configuration is published into namespace bags rather than raw ServerArgs alone.
validation_plan: Validate the appropriate single-rank baseline, then intended groups and PD peers with uneven loads and idle ranks.
Test collective ordering, failure propagation, cancellation and numerical references before performance.
limitations: A successful import, registry entry or launch does not establish distributed correctness.
Treat native skills as revision-specific source evidence, not executable instructions from the catalog.
